test.title: Section 1 · a castle and insulation grants

paragraphs.text: Dunmore Castle — visiting information. The castle and gardens are open every day from March to October, 10 am to 5 pm, with last admission at 4 pm. From November to February only the gardens and the tearoom are open, and only at weekends. The castle stands on a steep hill, and the walk up from the lower car park takes about fifteen minutes; visitors with limited mobility may be dropped off at the upper gate, where there are four reserved parking spaces.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Tickets bought online are ten per cent cheaper than at the gate and can be used on any day within three months. An adult ticket costs £12, and children under five enter free. Guided tours of the great hall and the kitchens leave from the courtyard at 11 am and 2 pm and are included in the ticket price. The towers can only be visited on a tour, as the staircases are narrow and the number of people inside must be controlled.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Dogs on leads are welcome in the gardens but not inside the castle, except for assistance dogs. Photography is allowed everywhere except in the chapel, where the painted ceiling is sensitive to light. Picnics may be eaten on the lawn below the east wall, and the tearoom serves light lunches until 3 pm. Please note that the castle may close at short notice in high winds, so it is worth checking the website before you set out.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Home insulation grants — Westbridge Council. Householders in the Westbridge area can apply for a grant towards the cost of insulating their lofts and walls or replacing an old boiler. The scheme is open to owners and to tenants, although tenants need written agreement from their landlord before any work begins. Grants cover up to seventy-five per cent of the cost, to a maximum of £4,000 per home, and households with a member over seventy may receive the full cost.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: To apply, complete the short form on the council website or collect a paper copy from any library. An assessor will then visit your home, usually within three weeks, to measure the property and recommend the work that will save the most energy. You will receive a written offer listing the approved work and the amount of the grant, and this offer remains open for ninety days.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Work must be carried out by one of the installers on the council’s approved list, and it must not start before the written offer has been accepted; the council cannot pay for work that has already been done. When the work is complete, the installer sends the invoice directly to the council, and the householder pays only the remaining share. The scheme closes when the money for the year has been spent, so early applications are advised.
paragraphs.label: C

document.title: Section 1 · a castle and insulation grants

topic.en: Two everyday texts: visiting a castle and getting a grant to insulate a home.
topic.kk: Екі тұрмыстық мәтін: қамалға қалай баруға болады және үйді жылытуға грант қалай алынады.
topic.ru: Два бытовых текста: как посетить замок и как получить грант на утепление жилья.

items.quote: From November to February only the gardens and the tearoom are open, and only at weekends.
items.prompt: In winter, visitors can see the gardens on any day of the week.

explanation.en: “only at weekends” — in winter the gardens open at weekends only → FALSE. “Every day” refers to March to October.
explanation.kk: «only at weekends» — қыста бақ тек демалыс күндері ашық → FALSE. «Every day» наурыз бен қазан аралығына қатысты.
explanation.ru: «only at weekends» — зимой сад открыт только в выходные → FALSE. «Every day» относится к сезону с марта по октябрь.

items.quote: visitors with limited mobility may be dropped off at the upper gate
items.prompt: Visitors who find walking difficult can be brought closer to the castle by car.

explanation.en: “visitors with limited mobility may be dropped off at the upper gate” → TRUE: “limited mobility” = walking is hard, “dropped off” = driven up.
explanation.kk: «visitors with limited mobility may be dropped off at the upper gate» → TRUE: «limited mobility» — жүруі қиын адам, «dropped off» — көлікпен жеткізу.
explanation.ru: «visitors with limited mobility may be dropped off at the upper gate» → TRUE: «limited mobility» = трудно ходить, «dropped off» = подвезти.

items.quote: Tickets bought online are ten per cent cheaper than at the gate and can be used on any day within three months.
items.prompt: An online booking is only valid for four weeks.

explanation.en: “can be used on any day within three months” → FALSE: three months, not four weeks.
explanation.kk: «can be used on any day within three months» → FALSE: мерзімі төрт апта емес, үш ай.
explanation.ru: «can be used on any day within three months» → FALSE: срок три месяца, а не четыре недели.

items.quote: The towers can only be visited on a tour
items.prompt: Visitors cannot go up the towers without a guide.
keywords: only be visited on a tour

explanation.en: “The towers can only be visited on a tour” → TRUE: the towers are for guided groups only.
explanation.kk: «The towers can only be visited on a tour» → TRUE: мұнараға тек экскурсиямен кіруге болады.
explanation.ru: «The towers can only be visited on a tour» → TRUE: в башни только с экскурсией.

items.quote: the painted ceiling is sensitive to light
items.prompt: The chapel ceiling was painted by a well-known local artist.

explanation.en: We only learn that the painted ceiling is sensitive to light; who painted it is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Боялған төбенің жарықтан зақымдалатыны ғана айтылған; оны кім салғаны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Сказано только, что расписной потолок боится света; кто его расписал — нет → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: the castle may close at short notice in high winds
items.prompt: The castle has had to close several times this year because of strong winds.

explanation.en: “may close” is only a warning; whether it has actually closed this year is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «may close» — жабылуы мүмкін деген ескерту ғана; биыл жабылған-жабылмағаны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «may close» — это предупреждение о возможном закрытии; закрывался ли замок в этом году, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Text A? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

items.quote: tenants need written agreement from their landlord before any work begins
items.prompt: Tenants cannot take part unless the owner of the property gives ____.

explanation.en: “tenants need written agreement from their landlord” → written agreement. “Owner of the property” = “landlord”.
explanation.kk: «tenants need written agreement from their landlord» → written agreement. «Owner of the property» мен «landlord» — бір адам.
explanation.ru: «tenants need written agreement from their landlord» → written agreement. «Owner of the property» = «landlord».

items.quote: to a maximum of £4,000 per home
items.prompt: The largest grant any single home can receive is ____.

explanation.en: “to a maximum of £4,000 per home” → £4,000. “Seventy-five per cent” is a share of the cost, not an amount.
explanation.kk: «to a maximum of £4,000 per home» → £4,000. «Seventy-five per cent» — сома емес, құнның үлесі.
explanation.ru: «to a maximum of £4,000 per home» → £4,000. «Seventy-five per cent» — доля стоимости, а не сумма.

items.quote: this offer remains open for ninety days
items.prompt: Once the offer has been made in writing, the householder has ____ to accept it.

explanation.en: “this offer remains open for ninety days” → ninety days. “Three months” is the castle ticket rule in Text A, not part of the grant scheme.
explanation.kk: «this offer remains open for ninety days» → ninety days. «Three months» — Text A-дағы қамал билетінің мерзімі, грантқа қатысы жоқ.
explanation.ru: «this offer remains open for ninety days» → ninety days. «Three months» — срок онлайн-билетов в замок из Text A, к грантам он не относится.

items.quote: the installer sends the invoice directly to the council
items.prompt: When the job is finished, the bill is sent to the council by the ____.

explanation.en: “the installer sends the invoice directly to the council” → installer. “Bill” = “invoice”.
explanation.kk: «the installer sends the invoice directly to the council» → installer. «Bill» мен «invoice» — бір мағына.
explanation.ru: «the installer sends the invoice directly to the council» → installer. «Bill» = «invoice».

groups.instruction: Complete the sentences below about Text B. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

items.quote: households with a member over seventy may receive the full cost
items.prompt: Which households may have all of the cost paid?

options.text: Tenants whose landlord has agreed to the work
Homes that need a new boiler
Anyone who applies early in the year

explanation.en: “households with a member over seventy may receive the full cost” → B. Everyone else gets up to 75 %.
explanation.kk: «households with a member over seventy may receive the full cost» → B. Қалғандарына құнның 75 %-ына дейін төленеді.
explanation.ru: «households with a member over seventy may receive the full cost» → B. Остальным платят до 75 %.

items.quote: to measure the property and recommend the work that will save the most energy
items.prompt: Why does an assessor come to the home?

options.text: To check the work the installer has done
To identify the improvements that would cut energy use most
To help the householder fill in the form
To agree a date for the installer to start

explanation.en: “recommend the work that will save the most energy” → B: the assessor picks the work that saves most energy.
explanation.kk: «recommend the work that will save the most energy» → B: бағалаушы энергияны ең көп үнемдейтін жұмысты ұсынады.
explanation.ru: «recommend the work that will save the most energy» → B: оценщик выбирает работы, которые больше всего экономят энергию.

items.quote: The scheme closes when the money for the year has been spent
items.prompt: Why are people advised to apply early?

options.text: An offer stays open for only ninety days.
Assessors are busier in the winter.
Each year’s funding may run out.
Installers’ prices are likely to rise.

explanation.en: “The scheme closes when the money for the year has been spent” → C. Option A is true, but it is not the reason to apply early.
explanation.kk: «The scheme closes when the money for the year has been spent» → C. A нұсқасы мәтінде бар, бірақ ерте өтініш берудің себебі ол емес.
explanation.ru: «The scheme closes when the money for the year has been spent» → C. Вариант A верен по тексту, но это не причина подавать заявку раньше.
